# SYNTHETIC ECW336 u-boot environment — structure only.
#
# Shape and variable set are copied from a real ECW336 (u-boot
# 2016.01-ECW336-uboot_version:V1.0.0, firmware 1.8.118-12), but every
# per-unit value is a stand-in: `ethaddr` is the Qualcomm dummy u-boot itself
# falls back to, and `snextra` is a synthetic Code27-valid serial. The real
# MAC and serial are identity material (the controller pre-shared key is
# derived from them), so they are not published here.
#
# What this fixture pins:
#   - `active_fw` is present and is the A/B selector (0 = FW1, 1 = FW2);
#     `app_part` sits next to it and is NOT the selector.
#   - `cloud_id` is ABSENT on a stock unit. That is the default that routes the
#     init at EnGenius Cloud and makes force_ac / DHCP opt-43 / mDNS look
#     broken, because in that mode nothing reads them.
#   - `rootfsname` is absent, as on the EWS377-FIT: this generation boots
#     without it, so only --strict should demand it.
#   - `hw_id` 01010123 = vendor 0x0101 (257) + product 0x0123 (291), matching
#     header product_id 291.
baudrate=115200
bootcmd=bootipq
bootdelay=2
active_fw=0
app_part=0
machid=0x8010006
hw_id=01010123
hw_ver=0101
ethaddr=00:03:7f:ba:db:ad
ipaddr=192.168.1.1
serverip=192.168.1.10
sn=000000001
snextra=2290E4T0001M
soc_hw_version=0x20020100
stderr=serial@78B3000
stdin=serial@78B3000
stdout=serial@78B3000
